description: This file defines a service class 'TagService' in a Spring Boot application for managing Tag entities, including methods for retrieving, saving, counting, and deleting tags.

classes.name: TagService
classes.description: A Spring Service class that provides methods for managing Tag entities in the application.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Tag by its ID, returning an Optional<Tag>.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Tag by its name, trimming whitespace, returning an Optional<Tag>.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all Tag entities.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a Tag if a Tag with the same name does not already exist.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of Tag entities.
